correctness.rationale: The eight-state triad identity gives the sharp (2/3)^gamma error. Equation (4) transfers this to normalized payoffs. The Fermi logistic derivative is bounded by 1/4, yielding the one-update total-variation estimate; mutation and common randomization are contractions. Telescoping proves finite-time convergence. Positive mutation makes the finite chain irreducible and aperiodic, and entrywise kernel convergence plus uniqueness gives stationary convergence.
